english: 78-79. Then he shall perform the Mārjana (wiping off) rite nine times repeating the three Mantras “āpo hi ṣṭhā” etc.[6] in this order dropping water on the ground, on the head, in the sky, (again) in the sky, on the ground, on the head, on the head, in the sky and on the ground.
